JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py:918 compares fitted currents with an independent weighted least-squares solution and lines 401-472 force qualification refusals, but tests/test_magnetics_fit_efit_comparison.py:1936 has no truncated-profile case and therefore survives the q95 coordinate defect.

SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: capability searches for weighted inversion, diagnostic loop integration, IMAS comparison, receipt writing, stationary points and plotting found the owners in magnetics_fit.py, measurement.py, mast_efit_referee.py, nova/io/json.py, flux_surface_connectivity.py and nova/media/poloidal.py, and the additions extend or call these owners rather than introducing another inverse or comparator.
FINDING nova/imas/mast_efit_referee.py:433 blocking: q95 normalizes profiles_1d.psi by its sampled endpoints instead of global_quantities.psi_axis/psi_boundary; the new _as_equilibrium caller in tests/test_magnetics_fit_efit_comparison.py:1630 samples only through edge_psi_norm=0.97, so a profile q equal to physical normalized flux returns 0.9215 instead of 0.95 and can incorrectly pass or fail the q95 band; normalize to the physical span and add a truncated-profile regression case.

No existing adapter for flattened mis-split EFIT output constraints was found in nova/scripts/benchmarks.

reuse_search.production: Added loop_fraction/loop_quadrature extend Magnetics; nested fit_receipt extends MagneticsFit; _score_imas_equilibrium extends score_with_efit_referee and reuses existing _boundary_distance. No other production inverse call site found.
